# Routes live in app-core as TanStack Router files, split by hand

- Status: accepted
- Date: 2026-11-19

## Context

The app needs routing, with four constraints: routes belong to `@repo/app-core`, so the three bundler apps stay plain wrappers ([0006](0006-bundler-independent-app.md)); Vite, Rspack and esbuild must build and split pages the same way; a link to a route that doesn't exist must fail the type check; and opening or reloading any page must work on every dev server, preview server, AWS and Netlify.

A spike on 2026-11-18 (`@tanstack/router-plugin` 1.169.0, `@tanstack/react-router` 1.170.46, esbuild 0.28.2) found:

- `autoCodeSplitting: true` on esbuild throws: "route code splitting (`autoCodeSplitting`) is not supported with esbuild".
- The esbuild plugin never writes `routeTree.gen.ts`, so a clean build fails with `Could not resolve "./routeTree.gen"` (as in [TanStack/router#3461](https://github.com/TanStack/router/issues/3461), closed but still reproducible).
- `tsr generate` plus a `.lazy.tsx` route builds on esbuild into its own file, absent from the entry.
- Deep links were not served: the esbuild dev server and `serve ./dist` had no `index.html` fallback, Vite built relative asset URLs (`base: ''`), CloudFront mapped 403/404 to pages that don't exist, and Netlify had no redirect.

## Decision

- **TanStack Router.** React Router's typed routes need its framework mode and Vite plugin ([type safety](https://reactrouter.com/explanation/type-safety)); its data mode runs on any bundler but has no route types.
- **File-based routes in `packages/app-core/src/routes/`, generated by `@tanstack/router-cli`.** The CLI writes the route tree without a bundler ([router CLI](https://tanstack.com/router/latest/docs/framework/react/installation/with-router-cli)), so no bundler app imports `@tanstack/router-plugin`. `tsr watch` runs as app-core's `dev` script, so `pnpm dev:app` regenerates on save.
- **Each page splits by hand: `page.tsx` for route options, `page.lazy.tsx` for what renders.** Automatic splitting needs the bundler plugin and "will NOT work if you are only using the CLI" ([code splitting](https://tanstack.com/router/latest/docs/framework/react/guide/code-splitting)). Lazy files read typed data with `getRouteApi`, never by importing `Route`.
- **`routeTree.gen.ts` is committed.** "Don't gitignore your `routeTree.gen.ts` file. This file is part of your application." ([discussion #1218](https://github.com/TanStack/router/discussions/1218)). `Verify: Code` regenerates it and fails on a difference; the formatter, oxlint and knip's unused-export check skip it.
- **`pnpm check:page-split`** fails a build whose startup scripts (`index.html`'s scripts and their static imports) contain a page's component, found by its `data-testid`. `check:size` sums every file, so it can't tell.
- **Deep links:** absolute asset URLs on every bundler (`base: '/'`, `publicPath: '/'`); an `index.html` fallback on the esbuild dev server and `serve -s` previews; Netlify `/* /index.html 200`; on CloudFront a viewer-request function that rewrites paths without a file extension to `/index.html`, so a missing asset still gets a 404.
- **`/demo/asset-imports`**, two levels deep, holds the asset-loading cards, and the `@smoke` test opens it directly: a relative asset URL then breaks on every bundler in CI.
- **One router package: app-core.** TanStack's monorepo examples put routes in their own package so feature packages get typed links ([router-monorepo-simple-lazy](https://github.com/TanStack/router/tree/main/examples/react/router-monorepo-simple-lazy)); no package here links to a route.

## Rejected

- React Router 8 in data mode: no typed routes.
- Code-based routing: no generator, but TanStack calls it "not recommended for most applications" ([code-based routing](https://tanstack.com/router/latest/docs/framework/react/routing/code-based-routing)).
- The bundler plugins: three configs instead of one, and esbuild's neither writes the tree nor splits.
- CloudFront 403/404 → `/index.html` with status 200: simpler, but a missing asset also gets the app's HTML with 200.
- Relative asset URLs (`base: ''`): break on any page two levels deep.

## Consequences

- Adding a page is two files and a regenerate: [`docs/template/routing.md`](../routing.md).
- The app must be served from the domain root.
- On CloudFront, a path whose last part has a dot (`/users/jane.doe`) is treated as a file.
- An unknown path returns 200 with the app's "Page not found" screen, not a 404: only a server that knows the routes could do better, and SSR is out of scope.
- Sentry names page views by route through `tanstackRouterBrowserTracingIntegration`, which replaces 0012's naming by path.
- The router adds about 14 kB (Brotli) to the main JavaScript.
